description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmpEmergencyContactDao' responsible for managing CRUD operations and queries related to employee emergency contact records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching emergency contacts, utilizing an ORM query builder.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for performing database operations related to employee emergency contacts within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee emergency contact. Assigns a sequence number if needed and validates the sequence number range before persisting.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee emergency contact by employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingSeqNosForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing sequence numbers for a given employee to check for duplicates or existing entries.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes multiple emergency contact entries for an employee based on provided sequence numbers.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Retrieves all emergency contacts for a specific employee, sorted by name.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Performs a filtered search of emergency contacts based on search parameters, with pagination support.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object configured with search filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of emergency contacts matching the search filters.
